correctness.rationale: The new claim is exact online Littlestone ranks only. A direct common-positive-fiber classification bounds both online ranks by three for arbitrary mixed alphabet factors. Closed two-row rook graphs have a negative root version space on one coordinate line, so depth three is impossible, while open (2,3) rectangles have root-positive fibers of only three centers. Existing static ranks and explicit supports supply depth-two/three lower bounds; two completely verified ternary 3x3 mistake trees handle the only rank-three despite VC-two case. The independent saved checker confirms 26 grid systems and sixteen adaptive tree leaves. Universal statements rely on proofs, not finite testing.

originality.rationale: Already-covered exact closed mixed-alphabet VC dimensions, exact open rectangular support counts and equal-alphabet online dimensions were explicitly excluded from the new claim. The new claim is the exact simultaneous open and closed Littlestone-dimension classification for heterogeneous Cartesian-clique products. In particular, old closed VC rank two does not determine online rank two, since ternary rook graphs have VC two but online three. A separate uniform negative-version-space proof supplies the missing two-row adaptive bound. Relevant original literature and directly comparable earlier mathematical claims did not yield the new heterogeneous online table. Historical priority remains uncertain.
